title: VTC Events — Invitations — Send — payload
description: Invite members to an event by name: a host invites any active member, and the invitation admits them to the audience; where the event allows it, a member of the audience invites another member of it. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

entryIds.description: The members to invite, by entry.

Response.title: VTC Events — Invitations — Send — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/invitations/send/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/invitations/send/0.1#response.

invitations.description: One per entry named, in the order named: new, or the invitation that already stood.
